relationships.evidence_quote: Anti-CGRP MAbs have a positive impact in the workforce significantly reducing absenteeism and presenteeism.

key_findings: In 148 employed migraine patients, anti-CGRP mAbs reduced absenteeism and presenteeism, with 159.8 euros net savings per patient at 3 months.
41.2% were responders; partial responders also showed positive cost-benefit.
